تستحلفوا (form X)
# تَسْتَحْلِفُوا (tastaḥlifū) /tas.taħ.li.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْلَفَ (istaḥlafa)
# تُسْتَحْلَفُوا (tustaḥlafū) /tus.taħ.la.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحْلَفَ (istaḥlafa)
